Record Class MeasureEntry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.MeasureEntry
Record Components:
key - the measure the bound applies to
bound - which way the measure may not move
limit - the value it may not pass
slack - the margin a tightening keeps; zero for exact counts
reason - why the bound is where it is — carried into the receipt
since - ISO date the bound was recorded
entryMode - per-entry enforcement override, as for AcceptedEntry.entryMode(); null inherits
public record MeasureEntry(String key, MeasureEntry.Bound bound, double limit, double slack, String reason, String since, LedgerMode entryMode) extends Record
One bound the ledger places on a measure (ike-issues#1207): a count that may not rise above a value, or a coverage that may not fall below one.

A bound is ratcheted the way accepted counts are, in the one direction that tightens it: at-most only moves down, at-least only moves up, and loosening is a human edit. slack is the room a mechanical tightening leaves — a coverage bound set half a point under the observation does not trip on the next build's rounding.

    • MeasureEntry

      public MeasureEntry(String key, MeasureEntry.Bound bound, double limit, double slack, String reason, String since, LedgerMode entryMode)
      Validates the entry.
      Parameters:
      key - the measure the bound applies to
      bound - which way the measure may not move
      limit - the value it may not pass; must be a finite number
      slack - the margin a tightening keeps; must not be negative
      reason - why the bound is where it is; null becomes empty
      since - ISO date the bound was recorded; null becomes empty
      entryMode - per-entry enforcement override; null inherits
